This file calculates the PSD and POC flux for the 2021 and 2023 data.

The POC calculation scripts here copy the Matlab functions in the file processPocFluxFromUvp.m associated with the Rufas et al. (2025) GRL paper. Some lines and functions were recoded to follow R conventions.
https://github.com/annarufas/Rufas_etal_2024_GRL/blob/master/code/processPocFluxFromUvp.m. The methods explained in Rufas et al. 2025 adapting the Bisson et al. 2022 approach of the truncated power law. In the truncated power law model in Bisson et al. (2022), the modelled particle count is lower for larger particles (stronger decrease with higher lambda). In this final version of the POC flux calculation, some of the functions in the processPocFluxFromUvp.m are not present here anymore.

Note that for UVP5, in Barth and Stone (2022), they removed the bottom 50m of each profile because they observed that the slowing of the CTD-rosette leads to high potential reimaging of particles. This is applied here.

Citations:
Rufas, A., Khatiwala, S., Bisson, K. M., Martin, A. P., & Bouman, H. A. (2025). Can We Constrain Geographical Variability in the Biological Carbon Pump’s Transfer Efficiency From Observations? Geophysical Research Letters, 52(3), e2024GL111203. https://doi.org/10.1029/2024GL111203

Bisson, K. M., Kiko, R., Siegel, D. A., Guidi, L., Picheral, M., Boss, E., & Cael, B. B. (2022). Sampling uncertainties of particle size distributions and derived fluxes. Limnology and Oceanography: Methods, 20(12), 754–767. https://doi.org/10.1002/lom3.10524

Barth, A., & Stone, J. (2022). Comparison of an In Situ Imaging Device and Net-Based Method to Study Mesozooplankton Communities in an Oligotrophic System. Frontiers in Marine Science, 9. https://doi.org/10.3389/fmars.2022.898057

# Load libraries and functions 
for calculating and modeling the POC flux at each depth
The PSD is based on the LPM (large particulate material) concentrations (# L-1) by size classes.
- In the calculatePocFlux function: the psd and binMiddle inputs are arrays for each depth bin. The zeros are not removed since these are summed.
- In the calculateModelledPsd: observedVol is a single value, and observedN/binWidth/binMiddle are arrays

alpha: particle dominance (smaller value, larger particles dominate)
lambda: the particle size (mm) where power law is truncated
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stats)

theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=16)))
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# This is the power law based POC flux model (Kiko et al. 2017)
calculatePOCFlux <- function(psd, binMiddle, binWidth) {
  particleEsd <- binMiddle

  # A = 2.8, b = 2.24 (used in Bisson et al. 2022)
  fluxFactor <- function(d) 2.8 * d^2.24

  pocFlux <- sum((psd/binWidth) * fluxFactor(particleEsd)*binWidth, na.rm = TRUE)

  return(pocFlux)
}

# For the truncated power law method in Bisson et al. (2022)
# NOTE observedN is the concentration * volume sampled
calculateModelledPsd <- function(observedN, observedVol, binWidth, binMiddle) {
  # Modelled particle number (# part./um), Eq. 1 in Bisson et al. (2022)
  modelledN <- function(x, d) {
    x[1] * d^-x[2] * exp(-d / x[3])
  }
  
  # log10 transform observedN and divide by bin width
  observedN_log10 <- log10(observedN / binWidth)
  observedN_log10 <- unlist(observedN_log10)
  
  # Only consider populated size classes and remove the ones that are not
  bad <- which(is.infinite(observedN_log10))
  observedN_log10_good <- observedN_log10[-bad]
  binMiddle_good <- binMiddle[-bad]
  
  # Initial guess and bounds for model parameters
  # PP: Originally, x0 is c(40, 4, 0.1) but I changed it to c(10, 4, 0.1) to reduce the warning "Error at i = ___ :  L-BFGS-B needs finite values of 'fn'"
  #   x0 is [C1,alpha,lambda]
  x0 <- c(10, 4, 0.1) # part L-1 / unitless / mm
  lower <- c(-Inf, 0, min(binMiddle_good))
  upper <- c(Inf, 6, max(binMiddle_good))
  
  # PP: In the original code, this is the fminsearchbnd() Matlab function.
  # Optimise model parameters using optim with box constraints (L-BFGS-B)
  opt <- stats::optim(
    par = x0,
    fn = function(x) {
      sum((observedN_log10_good - log10(modelledN(x, binMiddle_good)))^2)
    },
    method = "L-BFGS-B", 
    lower = lower,
    upper = upper
  )
  
  C1 <- opt$par[1]
  alpha <- opt$par[2]
  lambda <- opt$par[3]
  
  estimNbl <- (modelledN(opt$par, binMiddle) / observedVol) * binWidth
  
  # Remove particle size classes that are not in the observed set
  estimNbl[bad] <- NA
  
  list(estimNbl = estimNbl, C1 = C1, alpha = alpha, lambda = lambda)
}
```


# UVP6 POC Calculation
In this calculation, profiles are filtered first, then the particle concentrations are averaged in 20 m bins. The truncated power law function is then used to model the particle concentrations.

## POC Flux
```{r}
# The original data file organized in script file 2-*.R
# load("data/UVP6_ECOPART_Data_20260320.RData") 

# Recreating the above data file from csv files
uvp6_PAR <- read.csv("data/open_data_csv/uvp6_particles_compiled_202620929.csv")
uvp6_par_cnames <- read.csv("data/open_data_csv/uvp6_particles_column_names_202620929.csv")

## Establish the size class bins and bin width
bins <- uvp6_par_cnames %>% 
  filter(grepl("concentration", AnnotatedColumnName)) %>% 
  filter(Lower_limit_um >= 128 & Lower_limit_um < 16400) %>% # to match the 0.14-16.88 mm size range in Kiko et al. (2017) and Bisson et al. (2022)
    # calculate the midpoint as the geometric mean instead
  mutate(Size_class_midpoint_mm = sqrt(Lower_limit_um * Upper_limit_um)/1000)
  
colStart <- which(uvp6_par_cnames$Lower_limit_um == 128)[1]-17
colEnd <- which(uvp6_par_cnames$Lower_limit_um == 13000)[1]-17

# number of bins
UVP6_N_sizebins <- nrow(bins)
# Get width of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_width <- bins$Size_class_width_mm
# Get midpoints of size bins
UVP6_sizebins_mid <- bins$Size_class_midpoint_mm


# For Station_year and region metadata (Generated in script file 4-*.Rmd)
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
rm(indiv_traits, region_rename, volumes.df)
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

# Outlier profiles to exclude
to_exclude_200 <- c("AC20 2023","NaresW23 2023","NaresE23 2023",
                "RA38 2024", "RA06 2024", "RA07 2024", "RA08 2024", "RA31 2024",
                "RA42 2024", "RA43 2024", "RA73 2024", 
                "Kangalasiorvik Shelf 2024",
                "TCA-QFA1 2024", "de500 2021",
                "keb_S05 2024","RA72 2024","RA02 2024","RA52 2024")

to_exclude_500 <- c("RA46 2024", "RA48 2024", "RA50 2024", "RA45 2024",
                    "RA03 2024", "RA49 2024", "RA51 2024",
                    "TCAT6-03(A3) 2024", "129 2023",
                    "Sentinel 2024", "LSea-23 2023")

# Particle concentrations
particle.conc <- uvp6_PAR[, c(1,6,7,colStart:colEnd)] %>% 
  # Curate profiles (only include profiles part of the LPC flux calculation)
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year, reg.inuk, bottom_depth_m), 
            by = join_by(sample_id)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(station_year)) %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m > 10) %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_200) %>% 
  # Exclude depth bins 50 m  above the bottom depth (Barth and Stone 2022)
  filter(Depth_5m <= bottom_depth_m-50) %>% 
  # Calculate the observed particle concentrations by size classes per 20m bins and for each station_year
  mutate(Depth_bin = round(Depth_5m / 20) * 20) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") 


# *** Calculating POC flux ***
pocFlux_UVP6 <- particle.conc %>% 
  select(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_bin, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  mutate(ObsFlux = NA, ModelFlux = NA, 
         C1 = NA, alpha = NA, lambda = NA)

# This loop copies the script in Section 3 of processPocFluxFromUvp.m (Rufas et al. 2025). 
for (i in c(1:nrow(pocFlux_UVP6))) {
  a_par <- particle.conc[i, 7:27]
  a_vol <- uvp6_PAR$Sampled_volume_L[i]
  
  # No truncated power law model
  pocFlux_UVP6$ObsFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(a_par, UVP6_sizebins_mid, 
                                              UVP6_sizebins_width)
  
  # With truncated power law model
  observedN <- round( a_par * a_vol )
  if(sum(observedN) > 0){
    tryCatch( {
      trunc <- calculateModelledPsd(observedN, a_vol, 
                                    UVP6_sizebins_width, UVP6_sizebins_mid )
      
      pocFlux_UVP6$ModelFlux[i] <- calculatePOCFlux(trunc$estimNbl,
                                                    UVP6_sizebins_mid,
                                                    UVP6_sizebins_width)
      pocFlux_UVP6$C1[i] <- trunc$C1
      pocFlux_UVP6$alpha[i] <- trunc$alpha
      pocFlux_UVP6$lambda[i] <- trunc$lambda
    },
    error = function(e){cat("ERROR: at i =", i, " ", 
                            conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  } 
}

# For instances when the truncated power law model does not work, use the "observed"  value without the truncated power law model instead. This applies to  4 instances (< 0.1%)) and does not include the 200 m and 500 m depth bins of interest.
pocFluxErr_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>%
  filter(is.na(ModelFlux))
pocFlux_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(ModelFlux = if_else(is.na(ModelFlux),
                             ObsFlux, ModelFlux))
```

## Annual POC flux per subregion
```{r}
pocFlux_UVP6 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(poc_mgC_m2_d = ModelFlux) %>% 
  # Estimate the annual flux (winter:summer conversion factor of 0.25)
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr = if_else(reg.inuk != "NarSt",
                                (poc_mgC_m2_d + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d)/2 *365 /1000,
                                (poc_mgC_m2_d*122 + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d*243) /1000))
  
# Extract POC flux at 100m, 200m, and 500m reference depths
pocFlux.ave.100 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(Depth_bin == 100)

pocFlux.ave.200 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(Depth_bin == 200)

pocFlux.ave.500 <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_500) %>% 
  filter(Depth_bin == 500)

# Regional averages
pocFlux.region.100 <- pocFlux.ave.100 %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(poc_gC_m2_yr_mean = mean(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_gC_m2_yr_sd = sd(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_mean = mean(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

pocFlux.region.200 <- pocFlux.ave.200 %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(poc_gC_m2_yr_mean = mean(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_gC_m2_yr_sd = sd(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_mean = mean(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

pocFlux.region.500 <- pocFlux.ave.500 %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(poc_gC_m2_yr_mean = mean(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_gC_m2_yr_sd = sd(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_mean = mean(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

# Export results
```{r}
# Export results
save(pocFlux.ave.100, pocFlux.ave.200, pocFlux.ave.500,
     pocFlux.region.100, pocFlux.region.200, pocFlux.region.500,
     particle.nbss, martin_params,
file = "data/POC_flux_UVP6_20260515.RData")
```
